context:
North Star: characterize which bounded state observables and resource-response laws remain invariant under controlled substrate changes, under fixed resources and no post-result fitting.

Sealed public result: UP-LM9C-profile-family-invariance qualified PROFILE_FAMILY_EXACT_DEFICIT_LAW on 108/108 frozen rows. Parent UP-LM8C reproduced PERMUTATION_FAMILY_EXACT_DEFICIT_LAW. LM9C changed exactly one substrate dimension: the profile family from {deferred_only,layout_only,hybrid_min} to {deferred_only,layout_only,hybrid_max}, with hybrid_max frozen exactly as max(uplm3hDeferredTarget(a), uplm3hLayoutTarget(a)). Rotations remained {8,21}; permutations remained {identity,rotate1,random_fixed=[3,0,5,1,4,2]}; the six existing arms, prepressure loop, 32-write ceiling, deficit-law measurements, and correction policy remained frozen. Every row had write_error=0 and post_target_error=0; mismatch_rows=0. No adaptive selection, policy change, or live activation occurred.

Interpretation boundary: this establishes exact transfer of writes=max(0, pre_countdown-target) and post_countdown=target across the tested held-out rotations, changed permutation family, and the min-to-max hybrid profile-family change. It still does not establish invariance to arm construction, target primitives themselves, resource geometry, write ceiling, or correction policy.

Select exactly one next preregistered experiment with maximal information value. Change one substrate dimension only. Prefer a test that discriminates a genuinely structural deficit law from dependence on the current six-arm construction or another still-frozen substrate dimension. Preserve the existing law, target primitives, thresholds, rotations, permutations, profile family, write policy, and all dimensions not explicitly selected. Scientific negatives are valid. Return a concise plan containing: experiment ID/title, question, hypothesis, exact frozen parent/baseline, single changed dimension, frozen controls, measurements, classifications, and boundary conditions. Do not authorize execution.
